mapper.select: select count(*) from user u left join user_penalty p on p.user_id = u.user_id and p.penalty_id = ( select max(p2.penalty_id) from user_penalty p2 where p2.user_id = u.user_id ) where u.grade = 'User' and ( #{status} = 'ALL' or (#{status} = 'NORMAL' and (u.suspended = 0 or u.suspended is null)) or (#{status} = 'SUSPENDED' and u.suspended = 1) or (#{status} = 'PENALTY' and p.score != 0) ) and ( #{keyword} = '' or u.login_id like concat('%', '#{keyword}', '%') or u.nickname like concat('%', '#{keyword}', '%') )

select u.user_id, u.login_id, u.nickname, u.suspended, p.score from user u left join user_penalty p on p.user_id = u.user_id and p.penalty_id = ( select max(p2.penalty_id) from user_penalty p2 where p2.user_id = u.user_id ) where u.grade = 'User' and ( #{status} = 'ALL' or (#{status} = 'NORMAL' and (u.suspended = 0 or u.suspended is null)) or (#{status} = 'SUSPENDED' and u.suspended = 1) or (#{status} = 'PENALTY' and p.score != 0) ) and ( #{keyword} = '' or u.login_id like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or u.nickname like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) order by u.user_id desc limit #{row}, 10
